answer: Require each agent identity to carry a violet thread of attestation: a fresh, non-reusable endorsement from an already-established peer who stakes reputation that is slashed if the identity misbehaves, plus a time-locked bond that doubles per identity sharing the same funding source. One extra fake then costs a new independent endorser, a lost reputation stake, and twice the bond of the last - a ripple that makes farming the tenth identity far pricier than the first, not a flat fee a farm pays in parallel.
